name: ARDY Core RP 20FPS
description: NVIDIA ARDY, the real-time autoregressive successor to Kimodo. Starts exactly from the current pose.

code.install: Set up the isolated motion worker in the ComfyUI_VNCCS_Utils folder: 'motion_worker/install.sh ardy' then 'motion_worker/run.sh ardy' (Windows: install.bat / run.bat; Docker: docker compose -f motion_worker/docker-compose.yml --profile ardy up -d --build). See motion_worker/README.md.

requirements.notes: Most of the memory is the LLM2Vec text encoder (~14 GB in bfloat16); the motion model itself is small and generates in real time.

guide.summary: Recommended. NVIDIA's newest model: generates in real time and starts exactly from the pose you made, up to 10 s.
guide.best_for: Continuing your pose; walking, gestures, everyday actions; quick iterations
guide.setup_effort: Medium: one command sets up an isolated worker (needs CMake and a C++ compiler) plus a one-time Hugging Face access request

setup.label: Isolated motion worker
setup.detail: The model runs in its own venv next to this extension, so ComfyUI's packages are never changed and your other workflows keep running. In the custom_nodes/ComfyUI_VNCCS_Utils folder run the command once (it creates the venv), then keep the worker running next to ComfyUI. Windows (also ComfyUI portable): motion_worker\install.bat ardy, then motion_worker\run.bat ardy. No Python on the machine? Install uv first; the script then downloads Python 3.11 into the venv by itself. Optional, if you already use Docker: docker compose -f motion_worker/docker-compose.yml --profile ardy up -d --build

setup.label: Access to Meta Llama 3 8B Instruct (gated)
setup.detail: ARDY's text encoder is built on Meta Llama 3. Open the model page, accept the license with your Hugging Face account, then log in once with the worker's venv (Windows: motion_worker\envs\ardy\Scripts\hf.exe auth login; Docker shares the login of the host).

setup.label: Model and text encoder (~17 GB)
setup.detail: Downloaded by ARDY itself on the first generation, so the first run takes a while.
